environment.description: Terraform provider helper runs on a developer workstation (macOS/Linux) with network access from the local subnet. The AWS credentials used have IAMFullAccess managed policy attached directly to the IAM user. No SCPs applied (standalone AWS account, not in an Organization). No permission boundaries configured on the executing identity. The server binds to 0.0.0.0:19443 and is reachable from any host on the same network segment.
